name: task_finder
description: Automatically offers Composer, Node, Maidfile & Taskfile actions as Nova Tasks.

scripts.release: yarn test && yarn build && nova extension publish build/taskfinder.novaextension
scripts.pop-tests: open -a Nova $(find tests/projects -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name root-only | sort) tests/projects/root-only/child
scripts.test: rm -rf tests/.build && esbuild tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/unit/parsers/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --sourcemap --outbase=tests/unit --outdir=tests/.build --log-level=warning && node --enable-source-maps --test 'tests/.build/**/*.test.js'
